recognize_zh: 骨髓顆粒中成片的大型細胞，細胞質豐富淡藍紫色、帶細纖維狀皺紙紋理，核小而圓、偏心，細胞邊界融合成片，符合 Gaucher 細胞聚集。
features: Sheets of large cells with abundant pale blue-lilac cytoplasm and merging cell borders
Fine fibrillary, wrinkled tissue paper cytoplasmic texture
Small round to oval nuclei with coarse chromatin, eccentrically placed, one or two per cell
Scattered small dark hematopoietic cells and fat spaces within the particle
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a marrow particle largely replaced by sheets of large histiocytes. These cells have small, round, eccentric nuclei with coarse chromatin and abundant pale blue-lilac cytoplasm with a fibrillary crumpled tissue paper texture, with residual hematopoietic cells and fat spaces interspersed. Foamy vacuolation and discrete sea-blue granules are absent. Findings are consistent with Gaucher cells, to be confirmed by glucocerebrosidase enzyme activity or GBA1 genotyping.

ddx.vs: Pseudo-Gaucher cells in CML, myeloma, thalassemia or mycobacterial infection are morphologically similar, and are excluded by normal glucocerebrosidase activity and absence of such a disorder.
Niemann-Pick cells show uniform soap-bubble vacuolation rather than fibrillary striations.
Histiocytes filled with atypical mycobacteria show negative-image rods and are acid-fast positive.
